title: NovaFabric dashboard widget (ADR-0235)
description: A portable, self-describing chart definition: an ADR-0129 QueryPlan plus presentation. Recognisable when it arrives with no accompanying context - pasted into an issue, committed to a repo, mailed between organizations.

$novafabricWidget.description: Sentinel. Together with `version` this is what makes the file identifiable out of context.

version.description: Widget format version. Explicit so an older reader can refuse rather than misparse.

id.description: Stable identifier. Also the filename stem, so it is constrained to safe path characters - a widget is untrusted input (D7) and an id is the one field that reaches the filesystem.

query.description: An ADR-0129 query object. Validated a second time by the DSL itself, which enforces a closed allow-list - so a widget cannot express a query the CLI forbids.
